_doc: Real species. base = base stats; learnset = [[level, move], ...] limited to moves in moves.json (Gen 3 order); evo_moves = moves taught the moment the species evolves (the Gen 7+ "Evo." rule): always learned, whatever the level, on top of any learnset entry at the current level; filled from Bulbapedia/PokeAPI Gen VII plus FRLG's evolution-level repeats, limited to moves in moves.json (see docs/bugs/B41); moves = default kit for test labs. Sprites: drop files in assets/pokemon/<slug>/ (see assets/pokemon/README.md); 'sprite' + 'placeholder_tint' are the fallback until then. base_exp = experience yield; growth = experience curve (medium_fast / medium_slow / fast / slow / erratic / fluctuating); evolution = {level, into} for level-up; {method: item|trade, item?, into} for stone/trade evolutions (data only, never fire on level-up). gender_ratio = female chance 0..1 (-1 = genderless), from pret/pokefirered species_info.h. placeholder_scale enlarges the placeholder sprite. jump_height = hop height in metres computed from weight_kg/height_m by tools/gen_jump_heights.py (small and light = springy); 0 = cannot jump. jump_height_override wins for outliers. locomotion = ground|hover|fly: ground walks and jumps; hover floats a little (no jump, ground aoe misses, dashes hit); fly is always airborne (no jump, ground aoe and dashes miss). Set by tools/gen_locomotion.py, pending approval. swimmer = moves in water (all Water types, D63); fish = flops slowly on land and never leaves the water (the rod fish); pad = may take a floating battle platform (the gym buoys; Staryu yes, Goldeen no). abilities = Gen 3 ability slots in order from pret/pokefirered species_info.h (one entry = one ability, two = a 50/50 slot; ids in data/abilities.json, display only).

Bulbasaur.flavor: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

Ivysaur.flavor: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.

Venusaur.flavor: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

Charmander.flavor: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

Charmeleon.flavor: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

Charizard.flavor: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

Squirtle.flavor: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

Wartortle.flavor: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.

Blastoise.flavor: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

Pidgey.flavor: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.

Pidgeotto.flavor: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.

Pidgeot.flavor: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

Rattata.flavor: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

Raticate.flavor: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

Caterpie.flavor: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

Metapod.flavor: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

Butterfree.flavor: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.

Weedle.flavor: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

Kakuna.flavor: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

Beedrill.flavor: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

Pikachu.flavor: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

Raichu.flavor: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

Spearow.flavor: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

Fearow.flavor: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.

Mankey.flavor: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

Primeape.flavor: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

Psyduck.flavor: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

Golduck.flavor: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

Slowpoke.flavor: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

Slowbro.flavor: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.

Poliwag.flavor: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

Poliwhirl.flavor: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

Poliwrath.flavor: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

Goldeen.flavor: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

Seaking.flavor: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.

Magikarp.flavor: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.

Gyarados.flavor: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

Diglett.flavor: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

Dugtrio.flavor: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

Nidoran F.flavor: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.

Nidorina.flavor: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

Nidoqueen.flavor: The body is covered by stiff, needle-like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.

Nidoran M.flavor: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

Nidorino.flavor: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

Nidoking.flavor: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

Geodude.flavor: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.

Graveler.flavor: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.

Golem.flavor: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

Onix.flavor: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

Sandshrew.flavor: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

Sandslash.flavor: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

Zubat.flavor: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.

Golbat.flavor: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.

Paras.flavor: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

Parasect.flavor: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.

Clefairy.flavor: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

Clefable.flavor: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

Jigglypuff.flavor: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

Wigglytuff.flavor: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

Magnemite.flavor: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.

Magneton.flavor: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

Voltorb.flavor: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.

Electrode.flavor: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

Oddish.flavor: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.

Gloom.flavor: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

Vileplume.flavor: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.

Bellsprout.flavor: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

Weepinbell.flavor: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

Victreebel.flavor: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

Grimer.flavor: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.

Muk.flavor: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.

Koffing.flavor: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

Weezing.flavor: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.

Ekans.flavor: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.

Arbok.flavor: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

Staryu.flavor: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

Starmie.flavor: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

Horsea.flavor: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.

Shellder.flavor: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

Seadra.flavor: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

Kingdra.flavor: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

Cloyster.flavor: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

Vulpix.flavor: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

Ninetales.flavor: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

Venonat.flavor: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

Venomoth.flavor: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

Meowth.flavor: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.

Persian.flavor: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.

Growlithe.flavor: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

Arcanine.flavor: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

Abra.flavor: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

Kadabra.flavor: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

Alakazam.flavor: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

Machop.flavor: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

Machoke.flavor: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

Machamp.flavor: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

Tentacool.flavor: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

Tentacruel.flavor: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

Ponyta.flavor: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

Rapidash.flavor: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

Farfetch'd.flavor: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

Doduo.flavor: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

Dodrio.flavor: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

Seel.flavor: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

Dewgong.flavor: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

Gastly.flavor: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

Haunter.flavor: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

Gengar.flavor: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

Drowzee.flavor: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

Hypno.flavor: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

Krabby.flavor: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

Kingler.flavor: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

Exeggcute.flavor: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

Exeggutor.flavor: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

Cubone.flavor: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

Marowak.flavor: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

Hitmonlee.flavor: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

Hitmonchan.flavor: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

Lickitung.flavor: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

Rhyhorn.flavor: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

Rhydon.flavor: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

Chansey.flavor: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

Tangela.flavor: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

Kangaskhan.flavor: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.

Mr. Mime.flavor: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

Scyther.flavor: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

Jynx.flavor: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.

Electabuzz.flavor: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

Magmar.flavor: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

Pinsir.flavor: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

Tauros.flavor: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.

Lapras.flavor: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

Ditto.flavor: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

Eevee.flavor: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

Vaporeon.flavor: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

Jolteon.flavor: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

Flareon.flavor: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

Porygon.flavor: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

Omanyte.flavor: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.

Omastar.flavor: Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

Kabuto.flavor: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

Kabutops.flavor: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

Aerodactyl.flavor: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

Snorlax.flavor: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

Articuno.flavor: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

Zapdos.flavor: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

Moltres.flavor: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

Dratini.flavor: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

Dragonair.flavor: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

Dragonite.flavor: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

Mewtwo.flavor: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

Mew.flavor: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
